oos_duration: Three calendar years immediately following IS, ending at the supplied workbook endpoint.
cost_instruction: User explicitly requested no costs. No cost sensitivity is used this round.
prior_holdout_exposure: The 2023-2026 history was already plotted and inspected in earlier work. This is a development-isolated historical test, not virgin or newly collected OOS.
development_access: After workbook parsing, price and native feature rows after IS_END are removed before indicator/return/feature calculations. No full-sample outcome artifact is used as a development input.

screen.cost_instruction: User explicitly requested no costs for this round.
screen.freeze: One highest IS-ranked passing NEW filter per pair/strategy. All passing versions retained in IS table.

oos_screen.quality_confirmation: Separately report whether both gross trade win rate and payoff are no worse than BASE, with >=20 closed trades. Not a license to tune on OOS.

candidate_specs.label: Unfiltered technical baseline
candidate_specs.mechanism: Preserve the original technical targets and account clock.

candidate_specs.label: Entry volatility is not expanding
candidate_specs.mechanism: Avoid entry while short-horizon volatility exceeds its longer-horizon level.

candidate_specs.label: Entry volatility is not surging
candidate_specs.mechanism: Avoid a pronounced short-horizon volatility increase.

candidate_specs.label: Reject elevated and rising VIX
candidate_specs.mechanism: Avoid entry during an already elevated and worsening observed risk state.

candidate_specs.label: Entry move is not extended
candidate_specs.mechanism: Avoid following a directional move already larger than one 20-observation volatility unit.

candidate_specs.label: Entry agrees with 63-observation direction
candidate_specs.mechanism: Avoid a short-horizon directional entry against the longer observed price move.

candidate_specs.label: Require directional 63-observation path
candidate_specs.mechanism: Avoid trend entries when displacement is small relative to the traveled price path.

candidate_specs.label: Avoid strongly directional mean-reversion entries
candidate_specs.mechanism: Avoid fading a strongly directional 63-observation price path.

candidate_specs.label: Exit unrewarded mean reversion after 20 observations
candidate_specs.mechanism: Limit persistence in a mean-reversion episode that has not made progress.

candidate_specs.label: Exit unrewarded mean reversion after 40 observations
candidate_specs.mechanism: Allow more time for reversion while limiting persistently unrewarded exposure.

candidate_specs.label: Exit mean reversion at two entry-volatility units of loss
candidate_specs.mechanism: Limit adverse movement using volatility fixed at the original entry signal.

candidate_specs.label: Exit directional entry without progress after five observations
candidate_specs.mechanism: Limit a directional episode that fails to generate early cumulative progress.

candidate_specs.label: Trail earned gains by two entry-volatility units
candidate_specs.mechanism: After sufficient observed gains, limit giveback using volatility frozen at the entry signal.

candidate_specs.label: Stable-volatility entry and 20-observation reversion timeout
candidate_specs.mechanism: Combine entry volatility context with a no-progress time exit.

candidate_specs.label: Stable-volatility nontrending reversion entry
candidate_specs.mechanism: Avoid mean-reversion entries with expanding volatility or a strongly directional path.

candidate_specs.label: Reject the existing rate-change and dollar conflict
candidate_specs.mechanism: Retain the existing POLICY_USD predicate as a prespecified economic comparator.

candidate_specs.label: Reject the existing commodity and dollar conflict
candidate_specs.mechanism: For AUD/CAD/NOK, avoid a commodity move against the trade alongside a conflicting dollar move.

family_application: Each spec is applied to every compatible rule and currency; commodity comparator only AUD/CAD/NOK. No performance-dependent subset.
boundary_policy: Main evaluation preserves continuous positions across IS/OOS; PnL display resets only. Quality uses entries and closes inside each interval. Carry-in and censored trades are reported separately.
fresh_start_sensitivity: Zero prior positions; only original BASE episodes with execution entry on/after OOS_START may enter. No mid-episode re-entry.
schedule_delay_sensitivity: IS-only diagnostic: lag the fixed target schedule by one additional quote for both BASE and FILTER. Decisions are not recomputed under delayed fills; this is not an operational latency simulator and not a selection gate.
holdout_rule: Freeze one highest IS-ranked passing NEW filter per account, then evaluate every frozen candidate exactly as specified. No OOS-based re-ranking, rule revision or deletion of failures.
